Clean = clean_deferral() envelope with scored originals (item2.resumable_deferral). Scored originals are never repeated or replaced. A deferral with no scored original is retried as before.

Setup (0) and harness cleanup (-6) volumes are validated separately as device-reported state (OUTPUT_VOLUME vs session PERF). source_cadence.rule: 0 eligible device send intervals > 60 ms over every scored original window (prompt start -> reply end)
source_cadence.signal: firmware per-packet send trace (peer-option arrival-trace 1; kind 12 uplink_wire rows, device clock), the measure of the 2026-10-15 RF diagnosis (docs/echoear-uplink.md, Timing boundary)
source_cadence.readout: dump-arrivals only outside scored windows: before the prompt, repeated until pending <= 512 (at most 4 dumps; one dump reads at most 8192 rows in ~2.1 s while ~300 rows/s arrive), after the reply-end PERF, and after the turn
source_cadence.excluded: CONSOLE_WINDOW stats/wifi-stats +/-120 ms informational; acknowledged audio-idle intervals by containment; no link-backpressure excusal
source_cadence.completeness: trace enabled at both PERF endpoints; one session brackets the window; overwritten unchanged from the snapshot after the LAST pre-prompt drain (which must precede the window start) through the reply-end PERF to the post-reply readout; a send at/before the start and at/after the end; every RTP sequence step 1 from the last send before the start to the first send after the end. Otherwise the original fails closed and the record is labelled harness_failure.
source_cadence.rationale: Retained AEC-off traces 2026-10-14/15 (17 runs, 35,520 eligible intervals, including the bad-RF nights with 1.2-4.9 % arrival tails): 0 intervals > 60 ms, maximum 52.724 ms (7.3 ms margin), per-run p99 32.0-44.5 ms. The same traced AEC-on step-9 images show 0.37 % of intervals at 60-74 ms (32 ms AEC chunking), so this limit is specific to the AEC-off line.
source_cadence.configuration_cost: S1 adds the arrival trace (an 8192 x 32-byte external-RAM ring, a critical section per record; ~300 rows/s seen with both directions streaming, ~376 rows/s on later step-9 images) and three drains plus three trace-counter PERF reads per original to the configuration being qualified. Recorded per original in source_cadence.trace_cost (record rate, max pending, overwrite delta, every drain duration).
source_cadence.ring_capacity_note: Not a hard bound: the readout interval is lead (~1 s) + prompt (~2.2 s) + reply up to the 20 s deadline after prompt END + endpoint/export work; at 300-376 rows/s the 8192-row ring holds ~22-27 s. Strict windows 15.5-16.7 s and quiet_offline 5.7-5.9 s in the smokes; quiet_live is unmeasured. An overwrite fails closed (harness_failure).
source_cadence.excuse_firmware_backpressure_decision: decision 139b: every > 60 ms send gap fails S1 whatever the cause, including firmware send-budget stale-frame skips under Wi-Fi back-pressure
source_cadence.completeness_r2_reason: smoke-r17 (6913c4d): the ring fills between originals (~45-60 s at ~276-300 rows/s, 8192 rows) and ~60 OLD records are overwritten during the full pre-prompt dump; the r1 rule (baseline = pre-prompt PERF) failed every original after the first although no in-window record was lost (sequence-contiguous, no overwrite after the last drain).

decision_138.link_tail: computed and recorded for every e2e stage; report-only

s2.in_flight: 0 <= encode_frames - sent - encoded_queue <= 2 at each snapshot
s2.bound_rationale: A frame waiting W after encoding gives a post-encode send gap <= 20 ms + W, so W <= 40 ms bounds it at 60 ms. Retained item1 smokes: session maxima 13.9-23.1 ms; all retained PERF: p99 32.2 ms.
s2.limit: S2 counters cannot see a stall before encoding (PCM frames waiting in the framer or a stalled TX task).
